lines.text: Rapi opens her eyes.
There is no one in her arms.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: ... Red Hood?
Rapi looks around.
There is nothing.
Rapi quickly stands up.
Breathing heavily, she frantically looks around the area.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Where... Where?! Could she really be alive...?!
*Thump*
Rapi suddenly feels a sense of calm.
She places her hand on her chest.
Her mind feels at peace.
Red Hood was dead.
However, despite that,
she feels as if she is still with her somehow.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I will become you.
Rapi begins to walk.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Let's go back to the Ark.
Ark. Elysion Headquarters.
Two people walk speedily down a hallway.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What's her status?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Surprisingly normal.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: How long has it been?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Over four years.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I can't believe it. Have you checked the combat data?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Yes. It seems there have been more than 300 battles over the past four years.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Yes. Three, zero, zero.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: And that's only the number of large-scale engagements she took place in. If we include all encounters with Raptures, it's more than three times that.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... This is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Trust me, I felt the same, but the data doesn't lie.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Let's hurry.
*Whoosh*

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Over there.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: RR-15436. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm Ingrid, the CEO of Elysion.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Let me confirm again. RR-15436 is your name, correct?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: It's Rapi.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Very well, Rapi.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Fine. No issues.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... All right. I'm going to ask you a few simple questions now.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I only ask that you answer truthfully.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Did you participate in the Second Surface Reclamation War six years ago?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I do not know for long, but yes, I did.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: For two years, you took part in numerous operations, large and small, correct?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: After that, we suddenly lost contact with you for four years.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Where have you been during that time?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I was on the surface.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What were you doing on the surface for four whole years?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I was searching for a way back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Alone?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: There were a few Nikkes who joined me along the way.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: They all died.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: How did you get to the Ark?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I took the elevator.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Our data shows you engaged in over 300 battles during your time on the surface. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I don't remember the exact number, but battling with the Raptures was a constant feature of my time up there.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: And you survived all of those fights...

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I had to survive.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Welcome back, Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We plan on conducting a thorough examination, is that all right?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Have you detected any issues?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Th-there are no signs of corruption or Mind Switch symptoms.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: You're safe.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Would it be all right if I asked a question?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Please. Anything.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: What happened with the Second Surface Reclamation War?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We failed.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: That would have happened about four years ago.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: It must have been right after I went to the surface. Even back then, the situation was dire.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Yes. Two months after you last went to the surface, the Central Government officially announced the failure of the Second Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: So... it only lasted for two years and two months.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: So, what do we do now?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We have decided to adopt the tactics proposed by New Hope.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Our primary strategy will incorporate guerrilla warfare, carried out by elite Commanders and a small number of Nikkes under their individual command.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There would be no more large-scale deployments to the surface.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Are we buying time, or have we given up?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: So both.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I have no further questions at this time.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Please proceed with the examination.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: A mass-produced Nikke who survived on her own for four entire years.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Wandering the surface freely without hiding.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's a story that almost defies belief.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: She has an unbelievable amount of combat experience.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Perhaps this could...
*Tadadada*
*Whoosh*

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: M-Ma'am! Ma'am!

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Call me Instructor.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: This must be rather important if it justifies barging in here without knocking.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Y-you need to come see this! It's beyond my authority to decide what to do next.
The Ark. Elysion's Nikke Research Lab.
Rapi lies asleep on a bed connected to various machines.
Screens displaying Rapi's test results fill the wall.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: All right, what's going on?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Her body weight is more than twice the average.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: And most importantly... there are two cores.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What? Explain to me how something like that could happen.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: I-I have no idea. This is the first time we've encountered a case like this.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Although only one core is active, we have no idea how this is even possible.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Is there something else?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Within her NIMPH, the region dedicated to her sense of self is densely packed.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: We consulted the past records, and it was almost empty when she first became a Nikke.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Are you telling me she honed her own sense of identity over time?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: It appears so.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What about the brain scan results?

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Other than the abnormally extensive combat data, there were no other significant findings.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: We haven't been able to get access to certain parts of the brain, but considering it's only a week's worth of information, we doubt it's of any major significance.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... All right. Reconstruct her body based on this self-identification data.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I think it would be best to dispose of this current body with two cores.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: Are you sure we shouldn't look into it further?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There are too many unknown factors here. It's best to have only one NIMPH.

lines.speaker: elysionmechanic
lines.text: ... I understand.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: How do you feel about your new upgrade?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't feel particularly special.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It feels like this face and body have always been mine.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's the ideal image of yourself nestled within your subconscious. The fact it feels familiar to you is hardly surprising.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There is something I should tell you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Your body weighed over twice what it should, and contained two separate cores.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: That body was disposed of due to safety concerns

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but even your current body, which was generated based on your own self-identity data, exhibited the same anomalies.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: No matter how many times we tried, the results were the same.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Something embedded within your own sense of self caused this.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do you have any idea what that might be?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Very well. I understand.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: From now on, you will be affiliated with Elysion.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Further research will be conducted to utilize the output of the cores in your body.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do you have any objections to this?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: This research will proceed concurrently with your practical operations.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You will be assigned to a specific squad and participate in missions with them to gather data.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Is there a particular squad you would like to join?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If you have a preference, we will honor that request.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I want them to be strong.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Strong?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes. I want squadmates whom I won't have to worry about dying or falling apart.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Is there any particular reason why you care about this so much?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: There is something that I wish to become.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: In order to achieve that, I require strong allies.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What is it that you want to become?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Red Hood.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Hmmm.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: We have the perfect squad for you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's Elysion's elite combat squad.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I doubt you'll find anything lacking in them,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: nor they with you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I understand. Thank you.
